mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing primidone metabolism unpredictably and altering anticonvulsant levels; primidone induces multiple CYP450 enzymes which may reduce clotrimazole efficacy.
action: Monitor serum primidone levels and seizure control; consider antifungal alternatives with lower enzyme interaction potential; adjust primidone dosing if necessary based on therapeutic drug monitoring.
